crossRefs.note: I am poured out like water. All my bones are out of joint. My heart is like wax. It is melted within me.
I am still confident of this: I will see the goodness of Yahweh in the land of the living.
My soul faints for your salvation. I hope in your word.
For consider him who has endured such contradiction of sinners against himself, that you don’t grow weary, fainting in…
David was greatly distressed; for the people spoke of stoning him, because the souls of all the people were grieved…
Some trust in chariots, and some in horses, but we trust in the name of Yahweh our God.

Why are you in despair, my soul? Why are you disturbed within me? Hope in God! For I shall still praise him: my Savior…
Then I thought, “I will appeal to this: the years of the right hand of the Most High.”
I will remember Yah’s deeds; for I will remember your wonders of old.
I remember the days of old. I meditate on all your doings. I contemplate the work of your hands.
Who among you fears Yahweh and obeys the voice of his servant? He who walks in darkness and has no light, let him trust…
This I recall to my mind; therefore I have hope.
Yes, we ourselves have had the sentence of death within ourselves, that we should not trust in ourselves, but in God…
who delivered us out of so great a death, and does deliver; on whom we have set our hope that he will also still…
Then the Levitical priests arose and blessed the people. Their voice was heard, and their prayer came up to his holy…
In my distress I called on Yahweh, and cried to my God. He heard my voice out of his temple. My cry before him came…
I said, ‘I have been banished from your sight; yet I will look again toward your holy temple.’
Yahweh is in his holy temple. Yahweh is on his throne in heaven. His eyes observe. His eyes examine the children of men.
Blessed is the one whom you choose and cause to come near, that he may live in your courts. We will be filled with the…
Hear, you peoples, all of you. Listen, O earth, and all that is therein: and let the Lord Yahweh be witness against…
But Yahweh is in his holy temple. Let all the earth be silent before him!”

translations.web: “When my soul fainted within me, I remembered Yahweh. My prayer came in to you, into your holy temple.
translations.bsb: As my life was fading away, I remembered the LORD. My prayer went up to You, to Your holy temple.
translations.kjv: When my soul fainted within me I remembered the LORD: and my prayer came in unto thee, into thine holy temple.
translations.asv: When my soul fainted within me, I remembered Jehovah; And my prayer came in unto thee, into thy holy temple.
